Blueberry-Papaya Smoothie Bowl
By: Simmer + Sauce
Published: Thursday, August 19, 2021 - 1:26pm

Ingredients




1 cup fresh papaya, peeled, deseeded and cubed
1/2 cup frozen wild blueberries
1 banana, divided
1/2 cup almond milk
1 1/2 teaspoons chia seeds, divided
2 teaspoons date syrup
1 cup ice
almond granola, for garnish
flaked coconut, for garnish

Preparation

1 Using a kitchen blender add the papaya, frozen blueberries, 1/2 banana, almond milk, 1 teaspoon chia seeds, date syrup and ice. Blend on high for 1 minute. 2 Pour mixture into two serving bowls. Top with the remaining banana, thinly sliced, chia seeds, granola and flaked coconut. Serve immediately.

About

Kick off back-to-school season with this easy, healthy blueberry-papaya smoothie bowl that you'll love just as much as your kids.
